internship.title: The interface is only one part of the system.
internship.copy: An expanding interest in how people form expectations, make decisions, and interpret feedback informs the technical work. It is why usability, satisfaction, and understandable outputs recur across otherwise different projects.

target.copy: In the early questionnaire sample, residents reported only moderate familiarity with nearby stores and amenities. That observation became a fixed neighborhood map with category filters and walking-time zones.

ticket.copy: The project extended beyond the map. One intervention addressed food-safety misconceptions about leftovers among older residents; another focused on recognizing fraud and protecting property.
